title: hieracium silenii
intro: Hieracium silenii, commonly known as silvery cineraria or false hawkweed, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium silenii include its antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory properties, which help in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in Hieracium silenii include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and other phenolic compounds, contributing to its medicinal properties.
